nodes.label: ADR 0011: Reconciliation Strategy — Nightly Cron with Handler Replay
nodes.rationale: Webhooks remain primary; nightly cron (03:00 UTC via CF Cron) is safety net. Scope: platform Subscription list, per-tenant PaymentIntent.list (48h window), per-tenant Account.retrieve. Repair mechanism: same handler functions used by webhooks, Stripe object fetched directly (bypassing webhook signature). processed_webhook_events.source distinguishes 'reconciler' from 'platform'/'connect'. Manual trigger via admin.reconcileNow oRPC procedure.
alternatives_rejected: Pull-only periodic sync (higher API volume, lower freshness)
Reconcile via direct DB writes bypassing handlers (two code paths)
Hourly reconcile (higher API cost, no meaningful freshness gain)
